messages:
Aisha: quick sync on AttrV2 follow-up. main unresolved: how to guarantee cost attribution when cost_key can be added by late enrichment and we sample early.
Liam: i think we should avoid moving sampling downstream. that's costly. options: force cost_key at ingress, accept occasional misses, or emit a small indexed cost_claim when enrichment fills it.
Priya: i prefer cost_claim. enrichment can emit a compact record cost_claim{trace_id,cost_key,ts} to a tiny lookup store. billing does an O(1) lookup at join time. keeps sampler where it is.
Cole: agree but we need SLA on claim arrival. if claim is delayed beyond billing window we still lose tokens. we should 1) set TTL (7d) and 2) emit a placeholder status on initial ingest so we can metric missing-attribs.
Aisha: good points. also design for storage: CORE columns should include tenant_id, trace_id, cost_key (nullable), model_id, route, seq_len, ts. everything else goes to extensions blob (gzip, limit 2KB).
Liam: for hot keys like model_id/route we should map strings to integers via a dictionary service to avoid index explosion. store reverse map for human queries.
Priya: SDK migration: publish canonical keys and client shim that maps legacy names. server-side translation map for 6-9 months to catch stray traffic; log translation counts.
Cole: monitoring: billing_match_rate (% tokens with attributed cost), extension_blob_growth (bytes/day), and top-n extension cardinality. alert if billing_match_rate drops >0.5% or cardinality grows >30% w/w.
Aisha: rollout proposal: dual-write V1+V2 at 3% for 2w -> 20% for 2w -> 100% with org opt-outs. implement cost_claim store and ingress validation in parallel.
obs-bot: created ticket ORG-9450 "AttrV2 cost_claim prototype + rollout runbook" assigned to Aisha, Liam, Priya, Cole. :white_check_mark:
Aisha: thanks all, i'll draft the addendum and post a link here once it's ready.
